audit.why: Hwei is a long-range poke/zone mage support; Rell is a melee hard-engage tank with no gap-closer besides E's remount speed. The content layer's difficulty framing (Tricky, 7/10) is well grounded even though the ability name inside it is wrong (see point 4).
content.spikes already identifies the real power-spike pattern: Hwei out-poking level 1-2, first item widening the range gap, and Rell needing to flank with R rather than front-to-front late.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer repeatedly names Hwei's CC ability as "Subject: Fear (CC Paints)". Hwei has no ability called Subject: Fear. His real E is "Subject: Torment" (Riot description: 'Hwei envisions a series of torments... crowd control abilities: Grim Visage, Gaze of the Abyss, and Crushing Maw'), which is the slot carrying his hardCC and slow flags in champ-data/_kits/hwei.json. The 'CC Paints' descriptor is accurate for this ability (Torment is his crowd-control paint) but is attached to a fabricated ability name.
audit.why: champ-data/_kits/hwei.json lists abilities P Signature of the Visionary, Q Subject: Disaster, W Subject: Serenity, E Subject: Torment, R Spiraling Despair — there is no 'Subject: Fear' anywhere in his kit. E (Subject: Torment) is the only ability flagged hardCC+slow, cooldown 12/11.5/11/10.5/10, matching this text's role as 'the CC that gates every commit'.
audit.corrected: Replace every occurrence of "Subject: Fear (CC Paints)" with "Subject: Torment (CC Paints)" across winCon, enemyWin, breakdown.cooldowns, breakdown.feeding, loading, focus.text, dosFull[2].d, and two report entries; add the real cooldown (12/11.5/11/10.5/10s) into breakdown.cooldowns per the MUST-CONTAIN-A-NUMBER lint rule.
